subject: COI scope alignment, PO escrow clause, and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudshore.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@cloudshore.io
Date: 2028-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding packet - COI + subcontractor list (initial)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the warm welcome. Attached are our current Certificate of Insurance (CloudShore_COI.pdf) and a list of known subcontractors (Subcontractor_List.xlsx). We also completed the onboarding form you shared last week (Initial_Onboarding_Form.docx).

High level: primary limits are GL $2M / $4M, cyber coverage included with $1M limit. The COI lists our broker (HarborRisk) and includes our standard endorsements.

Let me know if you need endorsements added, additional certificate holders, or a W9. We can request any endorsements from our carrier; turnaround usually 3-5 business days.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Partnerships
CloudShore Systems
anna@cloudshore.io
(415) 555-0178

Attachments: CloudShore_COI.pdf (pdf), Subcontractor_List.xlsx (spreadsheet), Initial_Onboarding_Form.docx (docx)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudshore.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet - COI + subcontractor list (initial)

Anna — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few procurement/legal items before we can finalize PO issuance: 

1) Certificate endorsements: we need the COI to show Redwood Inference as certificate holder AND an Additional Insured endorsement on the GL. Please request endorsement language that includes primary and non-contributory wording and waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood.
2) Subcontractor coverage: can you confirm that subcontractors are covered under CloudShore's policy (blanket subcontractor wording) or, if not, provide evidence of coverage for the named subcontractors listed?
3) Escrow/PO hold: procurement will set the initial PO to "conditional — hold" until we receive the signed endorsement PDF. The PO number is PRO-2279; finance will not release payment until DocOps confirms endorsement and W9 on file.
4) Cyber liability: your COI mentions cyber coverage but doesn't show limits on the certificate. Please have the broker confirm the $1M limit on the COI or provide the cyber policy declarations page.

If you can ask HarborRisk for a single consolidated endorsement PDF we can accept, that will speed things up. Monica (procurement) and Markus (legal) are looped for any clarifying redlines.

Short next step: if HarborRisk can provide the endorsement + updated COI by end of day Friday (2028-06-18), procurement will clear the conditional PO for activation pending receipt.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudshore.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@cloudshore.io
Date: 2028-06-15T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet - COI + subcontractor list (initial)

Thanks Jasmine — quick follow-up after checking with HarborRisk: 

- HarborRisk can issue an Additional Insured endorsement with primary & non-contributory language and waiver of subrogation. They can produce a consolidated endorsement PDF.
- Cyber limit will be added to the COI as an endorsement reference; they can also provide a redacted declaration page showing the $1M limit.
- For subcontractors: we have blanket coverage for subcontractors on our GL, but for two recently engaged subs we will obtain named certificates as soon as you confirm which ones you need documented.

One question on the PO hold: CloudShore prefers that the conditional PO reflect "activation hold for endorsement" rather than "escrow" language in the description. Is that acceptable from your side? If Redwood requires escrow-specific verbiage for procurement records, let us know and we'll coordinate legal.

We aim to have the endorsement PDFs uploaded to the Drive link below within 72 hours.

—Anna

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudshore.io>, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-16T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet - COI + subcontractor list (initial)

Anna — appreciate the update. Escrow vs activation-hold language: procurement records require a note that payment is retained until endorsement/W9 are received and verified; "activation hold for endorsement" works as long as the PO notes the payment hold reason and expected next steps. Please include in your next upload: endorsement PDF, updated COI with broker contact, and W9.

Also, please confirm the two subcontractor names from your list that you will provide certificates for; we only need certificates for subcontractors who will handle Redwood data or have network access. If you prefer, list them and we'll indicate which require named coverage.

If HarborRisk can route the endorsement directly to markus_klein@redwood.com and procurement@redwood.com that will save time. Once legal confirms the endorsement language matches our minimums we'll clear PRO-2279 to "conditional - ready for activation" and schedule the first invoice to be accepted upon doc verification.

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Anna Lopez <anna@cloudshore.io>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: HarborRisk Broker <broker@harborrisk.com>, contracts@cloudshore.io
Date: 2028-06-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet - COI + subcontractor list (initial)

Monica/Jasmine — HarborRisk has confirmed they will issue the consolidated endorsement and updated COI referencing the cyber limit. I've asked them to send the endorsement PDF directly to markus_klein@redwood.com and procurement@redwood.com and to include the W9 we uploaded to our portal.

Per your question on subcontractors, CloudShore will provide named certificates for the following two subs that require network access: 1) BrightEdge Integrations LLC, 2) Northwave Solutions Inc. We'll upload those certs as soon as HarborRisk issues them (should be within 48 hours).

We agree to the PO phrasing "conditional — activation hold for endorsement" for PRO-2279. Once legal confirms the endorsement matches your minimums, feel free to move PRO-2279 to conditional-ready and advise on any billing cutover instructions.

I'll update the Drive link and reply-all when the endorsement and subcontractor certs are available.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Anna Lopez
Head of Partnerships
CloudShore Systems

Attachments: none at this step.
